General Notes for File Maintenance

File Maintenance functions are identifiable on the menu by the green diskette icon:

File Maintenance

Menu

Screen

Report

The screen is designed to maintain or view a single record at a time.

There is a feature to view the entire table contents at once in a grid, but changing data from the grid view is not supported unless enabled by custom development for the specific table.

All changes made to data are logged in an audit trail, detailing who changed the data, when it was changed, and the original and updated values for the changed data.

Control Panel Options

 

Screen Mode

Toggles what you will see in the main body of the screen

Single Record View

To maintain single records (most common use)

Multiple Record View

To maintain or view all records in the table (spreadsheet)

Audit Trail

To view all changes to all fields ever made to data
